data.long_meaning: Charumita is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'charu' meaning graceful and 'mita' meaning dear or beloved. It is believed that Charumita is a divine name, associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. The name Charumita carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charumita usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
